tonight.headline: Two Steelers on bye, one still in the lineup
body: Bad news first. Jaylen Warren is in a starting RB slot and Pittsburgh are on bye — as set, AVIATO projects 110.0 against Talla Metralla's 126.8. Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) did not practise Monday and plays Thursday at Baltimore. Kyler Murray, who throws to Jefferson and Hockenson, has a hamstring with no diagnosis; Carson Wentz is the backup.

Setting the projection lineup — Diggs into the FLEX, Gordon to RB, Likely at TE — takes AVIATO to 124.3, 2.5 short of 126.8. The Coker claim clears Wednesday 02:00 CDMX; it is the last move before claims lock.

case.label: Where the points are
case.body: Week 8 won 158.06 to 86.24 (archive); AVIATO are 3-5. ESPN gives Talla Metralla 59% on the projection lineup they have set: Burrow 21.5, Jonathan Taylor 19.6, Golden 17.3.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Michael Wilson starts for them with two broken ribs (Athlon 2 Nov), against Seattle, rated excellent against receivers (USA Today 3 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The projection lineup is set and AVIATO still trail by more than 10 after Sunday's early games — then the gap was roster, not lineup.

doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Still on Chem waivers in the 12:50Z file. AVIATO are 4th in priority this week. If the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 28 Oct 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Coker. The card that morning said drop Fairbairn — the second kicker. AVIATO still carry two.

case.label: The player
case.body: Carolina's No. 2 behind McMillan. A shoulder issue cleared before Week 8 (limited 26 Oct, full 27 Oct, off the report 28 Oct; FFCalculator ~29 Oct). Week 8: 5 targets, 2 catches, 36 and a TD (archive 9.6). Bryce Young starts. Week 9 home to Denver.

case.label: Why now
case.body: Warren and Metcalf are on bye; AVIATO have six RB/WRs for five slots and the spare is Kamara. Coker projects 12.0 — a coin flip with Diggs for the FLEX this week, depth when Pittsburgh return.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn 9.3 cannot score while Bass (9.9) kicks; Chem starts one kicker.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive). Untested if a rival with higher priority takes him.

doFirst.title: Start Diggs in the FLEX; Gordon to RB; bench Warren
doFirst.subtitle: Warren is on bye in a starting RB slot. Worth 12.3 projected points.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Pittsburgh are on bye in Week 9 (league file; Steelers.com 2 Nov). Warren projects 0.0 in the RB slot.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Gordon (16.5) moves from FLEX to RB; Diggs (12.3) takes the FLEX. Diggs caught an 8-yard TD in Week 8 and Daniels played the full game (ESPN 2 Nov); Antonio Williams led Washington in targets (NFL.com ~2 Nov), which is why 12.3 and not more.

case.label: If Tuten is out
case.body: Kamara goes into Tuten's RB slot; Diggs stays in the FLEX.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Nothing realistic — a bye scores zero. Only Diggs being ruled out would change it, and then Kamara or Coker takes the FLEX.

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Hockenson
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 10.8 — exactly the 2.0-point line; the lineup check labels it PROJECTION.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Likely 12.8, Hockenson 10.8. The lineup check classes a 2.0 gap as PROJECTION — set it, but it is the thinnest margin that is not a coin flip.

case.label: Against Likely
case.body: Philadelphia allow the 4th-fewest TE points (StatChasers 1 Nov), and Likely drew 4 targets in Week 7 before the bye. J.J. McCarthy is expected at QB, not formally named (NFL.com ~2 Nov).

case.label: Against Hockenson
case.body: Murray's hamstring is unresolved and Carson Wentz may start if Murray is limited (Vikings.com, Athlon 2 Nov) — news the projection may not hold, pointing the same way.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Hockenson outscores Likely in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.sources: Lineup check · StatChasers · NFL.com · Vikings.com · Athlon

whatWentWrong.title: A bye is still in the lineup
whatWentWrong.lead: Warren sits in an RB slot in a week Pittsburgh do not play — 14.3 projected points left unset.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The Week 8 lineup carried forward; Warren and Metcalf are both Steelers. The lineup check reads 110.0 as set against 124.3.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The two lineup cards above: Diggs for Warren, Likely for Hockenson.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and the as-set total still trails the projection lineup — then something else is unset.

whatWentWrong.title: The D/ST add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: On 28 Oct the defence add cut Coker instead of the spare kicker; the claim undoes it tonight or not at all.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Nothing in Week 8. In Week 9 AVIATO have one spare RB/WR, Kamara, behind a questionable Tuten.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The claim fails and Kamara and Diggs cover Week 9 with no loss against the projection lineup.

roster.footnote: No Week 9 game has started. Rows show the lineup as set; verdicts show the projection lineup. Grades are rank in points allowed to the position, StatChasers weeks 1-8 (1 = toughest).

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 14.3 below the projection lineup: Warren is on bye in an RB slot, and Likely projects 2.0 over Hockenson.

contingencies.then: Start Alvin Kamara (9.0) in his RB slot

worthALook.name: Giants D/ST
worthALook.lead: At Philadelphia with Tanner McKee: the free-agent swap if Stafford plays.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: Hurts is out for the season (blood clots); McKee has three starts and was sacked five times in Week 8. Philadelphia have allowed 23 sacks; Eagles implied ~18.75 (ESPN 2 Nov; FootballNationUSA 3 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: The Commanders D/ST slot changed hands on 28 Oct — the churn rule keeps it closed this week unless the gap is real. 7.6 against 6.2 is 1.4.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Thursday: if Stafford practises fully, add the Giants D/ST as a free agent after waivers clear (no claim) and drop the Commanders D/ST. If Stafford is out, hold.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.

case.label: What would change it
